respuesta.pregunta: In catalog-portfolio-api, what checks does a brand have to pass before I can activate it? I want to make sure my brands won't get rejected when I call activate.
respuesta.respuesta:
This part of the docs is identical in both documented versions, 0.0.1-test-bench-v2a and latest. Before a brand can be activated, it has to pass these validations:

- A main logo has been uploaded and processed.
- The category and site combination is valid.
- It complies with the regulations service requirements.
- All required fields are populated.
